challenge.name: Cache Money
challenge.description: The arcade's credit manager tracks every wallet in the house. The books haven't been audited in years, so help yourself.

records.findings_summary: Flag found via Heap UAF + tcache double-free on glibc 2.39 (cache-money, no PIE, partial RELRO): sun{s4fe_l1nk1ng_w0nt_s4ve_y0ur_tc4che} | Evidence: Withdraw prints ledger bytes -> unsorted bin fd/bk leak gives libc base (offset 0x203b20) ; Transfer bug frees source ledger but copies the (freed) pointer into destination -> use-after-free read/write ; Withdraw on the dangling wallet leaks the safe-linking-encoded fd = chunk>>12 -> heap leak ; Clearing the freed chunk's tcache key (offset +8) bypasses the glibc tcache double-free check ; Second transfer frees the same chunk again; poison its fd to 0x4040C0(.bss wallets) -> next malloc returns the wallet table
solution_steps: Analyze cache-money: menu heap manager, wallet struct {name[16]; balance; ledger*; size; active}
Vuln: transfer frees src->ledger then sets dst->ledger = src->ledger (freed pointer) => UAF + repeatable double-free
Leak libc: fill tcache 0x110 with 7 frees, then free an 8th 0x100 ledger into unsorted bin and read its fd via withdraw
Leak heap: transfer a 0x80 ledger into an empty 0x90 tcache bin and read the safe-linking-encoded fd
Bypass tcache double-free: deposit zeros over the freed chunk's fd/key through the dangling wallet
Poison tcache fd = wal_table ^ (chunk>>12); two opens return attacker-chosen addresses
Point one allocation at 0x4040C0 (wallets), forge wallet[0] with ledger=0x404040 (strtol@GOT), size=8
deposit(p64(system)) writes system into strtol@GOT; next menu option '/bin/sh' triggers system -> RCE
Run id / cat /flag* /ctf/flag.txt on remote to read the flag
evidence: Withdraw prints ledger bytes -> unsorted bin fd/bk leak gives libc base (offset 0x203b20)
Transfer bug frees source ledger but copies the (freed) pointer into destination -> use-after-free read/write
Withdraw on the dangling wallet leaks the safe-linking-encoded fd = chunk>>12 -> heap leak
Clearing the freed chunk's tcache key (offset +8) bypasses the glibc tcache double-free check
Second transfer frees the same chunk again; poison its fd to 0x4040C0(.bss wallets) -> next malloc returns the wallet table
Craft a fake wallet with ledger = strtol@GOT (0x404040) and size 8
Deposit system address into strtol@GOT, then feed '/bin/sh' as the menu option so strtol() becomes system()
Shell as uid=1337(cache_money); `id` and reading the flag printed sun{s4fe_l1nk1ng_w0nt_s4ve_y0ur_tc4che}; /ctf/flag.txt present
